rationales.dry.minLineThreshold: Self-audit wants duplicated blocks flagged as small as 3 lines; the 15-line default was calibrated for consumer repos, not for this project auditing its own analyzer code where a short duplicated block is still a real extraction candidate.
rationales.dry.similarityThreshold: 0.75 catches copy-paste-with-light-edit duplication that 0.85 misses; the looser match surfaces near-duplicates for the self-audit without changing what fires on external corpora.

rules.message: lokijs was replaced by better-sqlite3 in v3.1.0. Use the SQLite-backed CodeIndexDB instead.
flexsearch was removed in v3.1.0. Use SQLite FTS5 for full-text search instead.
The languages/ module is infrastructure. It must not depend on analyzers, which are higher-level consumers.
